evidence.reason: a real 1x peak, but it is not what this fault rests on

spark.explanation: The 1x peak is largest but there is a clear 0.5x peak at about 30 percent of 1x plus strong 2x and 3x harmonics. That pattern matches looseness rather than pure imbalance or misalignment. The machine and door move in phase at 1x, so the whole unit is shaking together and I agree with the rule verdict.
fix: Stop machine and redistribute the laundry load evenly
Level the cabinet on a solid floor and tighten foot lock nuts
Tighten cabinet screws and check door and panel fasteners
Remove any shipping bolts and confirm all feet touch the floor
check_next: Run an empty spin and see if high shake remains
Push cabinet corners by hand to feel rocking or soft feet

visual.description: The cabinet visibly shakes side to side outside its rest outline in the magnified view.
